words.prose: {{ar:قَدَرَ}} ({{tr:qadara}}) names scarcity as measured constriction. The syntax separates the Lord's measuring action, the person upon whom it bears, and the provision that is measured; that separation blocks the speaker's later collapse of limited supply into lowered worth. As a completed measuring action before the later speech, it forms the hinge where divine apportionment becomes the condition the human misnames. The broader root field of measure, capacity, decree, and power remains useful here because the hardship is calibrated apportionment before it is misnamed humiliation. The near construction in 65:7 reinforces that restricted provision can belong to measured allotment rather than dishonor. A doubled-dāl variant sharpens the sense of calculation, but it does not replace the local grammar of measured provision.

words.prose: {{ar:رِزْقَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rizqahu}}) names the resource-domain that is being measured. The suffix makes it his allotted provision, which explains the temptation to read the restriction as self-devaluation; yet the syntax keeps it as an object measured by another, not a possession under the human's control. The singular suffixed form presents one bounded share under measure rather than an open field under the human's control. The root range is wider than cash: sustaining supply, benefit, livelihood, and allotment all sit under the provider's domain. The measured-provision construction in 65:7 strengthens that restricted supply can belong to obligation and apportionment, not automatic dishonor. Because the object comes after {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}), the felt pressure arrives before the resource is named, and the later complaint turns the Sustainer's own domain into evidence for a status verdict. The word also supplies the resource-domain through which the prior prosperity scene (89:15) can be reread.

The quote names the sustaining Lord as my Lord before asserting humiliation, leaving almost no buffer between relationship and complaint. That title itself resists the inference: lordship carries nurture and governance, so measured provision is being charged against the very domain of sustaining care. Variant and recitational evidence can make the first-person yāʾ more audible, sharpening the personal address without changing the local construct relation. words.prose: {{ar:أَهَٰنَنِ}} ({{tr:ahānani}}) is not a generic hardship word. Its Form IV causative structure makes the speaker claim that his Lord has actively lowered him, and the first-person object makes the verdict about personal rank. The perfect form states the humiliation as a completed fact, while the root range moves from lightness and low weight into dishonor; the quote selects the status-lowering edge of that field. The clipped written ending and fuller recitational forms both keep the same me-object, tightening self-reference at the ayah's close. Here speech, lordship, and humiliation converge as a spoken accusation, not just as adjacent vocabulary. As the inverse of the honor claim in 89:15, the final word leaves the human diagnosis exposed for the rejection that follows at 89:17.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The test verb at word 4 governs a measured restriction at word 5, while the humiliation claim is introduced as the person's saying at words 8-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: A trial that discloses condition is applied through a scanting of an allotted gift. Speech-as-belief then exposes the person's hidden conversion rule: less provision means less standing. The humiliation is therefore the speaker's diagnosis of the measure, not a value judgment asserted by the narrative voice.

activation_trace.role: Testing that discloses a person's state makes the event diagnostic rather than merely adverse.
Narrowing something to a scant measure supplies the concrete pressure applied to provision.
Provision as an allotted gift makes the reduced amount an assigned share rather than a certificate of rank.
Speech as a held belief turns the quoted sentence into evidence of the person's evaluative doctrine.
Humiliation through contempt supplies the qualitative status conclusion that the person draws from quantity.

changed_reading.before: The Lord reduces the person's provision and thereby humiliates him.
changed_reading.after: The Lord subjects the person to a revealing constriction, and the person converts a smaller allotment into his own verdict of contempt.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The measured provision at words 5-7 is explicitly related to the speaker's Lord at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measure, deliberative arrangement, nourishing provision, and stage-by-stage nurture form an administrative model. On this reading, a narrow ration can belong to care's calibration rather than care's absence; the test is whether lordship is recognized when nurture does not look like expansion.

activation_trace.role: Measure reaching a thing's proper extent frames the restriction as proportioned rather than random.
Arrangement by estimate and deliberation gives the measured share an administrative function.
Nourishing food keeps the object of measurement tied to sustenance rather than prestige.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship a process of administering development.
The non-dominant nurture-and-growth branch keeps development live even when the immediate motion is contraction.

changed_reading.before: Care and honor are legible only through abundance and ease.
changed_reading.after: Lordship may proportion nourishment as part of staged nurture, so a narrow measure can be care's difficult mode rather than care's disappearance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins the trial root at word 4, material constriction at word 5, and a split humiliation or weakness root at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet also permits a bodily and social reading of scarcity. Constriction can wear a person down through use, thin sustaining material, and slacken effective strength. The speaker may be wrong about divine regard while still naming a real attrition of agency or standing produced by the trial.

activation_trace.role: Wearing out and becoming threadbare gives the trial a material attrition image.
Scanting the measure supplies the sustained condition under which attrition occurs.
Nourishment identifies what is thinned and links the pressure to bodily maintenance.
Being worn down through ordinary use translates scarcity into exhausted capacity and social commonness.
Weakening of strength and resolve preserves the complaint's phenomenological truth without ratifying its theology.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply makes a false doctrinal inference from scarcity.
changed_reading.after: The status verdict may be false, yet the speech can still register real wear, weakened agency, and felt abasement under a constricted means of life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from darkness through breaking light, uncovering, restraining reason, and reflective sight strengthens the focus trial as an exposure event. What comes to light is not merely reduced provision but the value rule by which the person reads it.

activation_trace.role: Testing and disclosure anchor the illumination sequence back in the focus event.
Daybreak emerging from night supplies the transition from concealed disposition to visible response.
Uncovering as something passes away makes disclosure an unfolding process rather than a static label.
Reason as a restraining barrier supplies the capacity that should interrupt the jump from amount to worth.
Reflective seeing by the heart turns visibility into considered interpretation rather than raw perception.

structural_cues: The sequence 89:1-6 moves from dawn and passing night into an appeal to see and consider.
At 89:6, root ك ي ف at word 3 has no branch inventory and serves only as a structural manner-question hinge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breaking light, uncovering, rational restraint, and reflective sight; I infer their sequence as an epistemic analogue for the focus trial exposing a hidden value rule. A live alternative is that they organize only the oath and historical question, without modeling the person's interior.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a private complaint caused by loss.
changed_reading.after: The constriction acts like disclosure: it brings the person's concealed equation of wealth and worth into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairing, singleness, and partition turn measure into a relational geometry of shares. A smaller or unpaired allotment can mark a distinct position without constituting lesser dignity, so the person's scalar honor ranking is not the only way to read difference.

activation_trace.role: A measured extent supplies the quantitative difference that the person misreads as rank.
An allotted gift makes provision one assigned share within a larger distribution.
Joining one thing to its like supplies the paired position in the distribution.
A single item without a pair supplies difference without itself assigning disgrace.
Separating a share and dividing a whole gives the differing measures a common distributive frame.

structural_cues: The paired and odd terms are coordinated rather than ranked in 89:3.
The partition image appears before the focus contrast between expansive and constricted conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, singleness, partition, measure, and allotment; I infer that unequal shares can be complementary positions rather than a hierarchy of persons. The live alternative is the loss-of-right branch under و ت ر, which can activate genuine deprivation when human distribution is unjust.

changed_reading.before: A smaller share necessarily marks a smaller person.
changed_reading.after: The measured share may be one differentiated position in a distribution, and its size alone does not determine the recipient's dignity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The historical sequence moves from created measure to boundary-crossing, multiplied power, and departure from sound proportion. It reverses the person's status calculus: unrestricted increase can disclose ruin, while restriction is not in itself evidence of contempt.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing to a scant measure anchors the contrast on the focus condition.
Contempt and abasement name the rank conclusion that the historical sequence destabilizes.
Forming by estimate and measure establishes proper proportion as the prior norm.
Crossing a limit in rebellion makes excess, rather than smallness, the decisive failure.
Increase in number supplies the expansion that becomes morally dangerous in sequence.
Departure from soundness and balance gives unbounded increase its corruptive outcome.

structural_cues: Verses 89:6-14 move from exceptional built power to transgression, multiplied corruption, and judgment.
The focus restriction follows a sequence in which abundance did not certify honor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, limit-crossing, increase, and loss of balance; I infer a causal sequence in which power without limit enables corruption and overturns the person's wealth-to-worth rule. The alternative is that the historical sequence concerns collective tyranny only and does not directly characterize private provisioning.

changed_reading.before: Restriction signals disgrace, while expansion would signal favor.
changed_reading.after: The preceding cases make unbounded expansion a possible route to disgrace, so restriction cannot by itself prove contempt.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated lordship spans ownership, historical governance, watchful presence, nurture, judgment, and return. The focus possessive therefore names a relation larger than a private patronage contract; the speaker shrinks lordship to the immediate amount delivered to him.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion anchor the personal address in ongoing administration.
Lordship as ownership and authority expands the relation beyond personal material comfort.
Nurture and completion at the return endpoint make the relation temporally larger than the present ration.

structural_cues: The same root recurs at 89:6, 89:13, 89:14, 89:15, 89:22, and 89:28 across sharply different scenes.
The focus speaker uses a first-person possessive inside that wider repetition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated lordship plus authority and nurture branches; I infer that repetition as one enlarged governing relation against the speaker's short-term patronage model. A live alternative is that each occurrence emphasizes a different role and should not be flattened into one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: My Lord's regard is exhausted by what He gives me now.
changed_reading.after: The speaker addresses a Lord whose ownership and nurture span history and return, yet judges that whole relation by one present contraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding verse places abundance, honor, ease, and a matching first-person verdict inside the same trial-and-speech frame. The focus is therefore the negative half of a controlled contrast: both material states expose the same habit of treating circumstance as a direct report of personal worth.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals condition anchors the constricted half of the contrast.
Scanting provision supplies the negative material pole.
Humiliation through contempt supplies the negative status verdict.
The same revealing test under abundance makes both conditions diagnostic.
Honor and praised generosity supply both the favorable treatment and the echoed positive verdict.
Good condition and ease form the experiential opposite of constriction.
Speech as belief makes the favorable sentence a matching doctrine rather than neutral narration.

structural_cues: Verses 89:15 and 89:16 repeat the conditional trial frame, the speech introduction, and the first-person address.
The material and status terms reverse while the speaker's inference pattern remains stable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-symmetrical syntax, the repeated test root, opposite conditions, and parallel sayings; I infer that both utterances are exposed human readings of circumstance. The alternative is that the favorable statement retains partial truth because benefaction and honor are genuinely present, even though the inference from them is overextended.

changed_reading.before: The focus complaint uniquely responds to an objectively degrading event.
changed_reading.after: It is one half of a paired diagnostic: abundance and constriction alike elicit premature verdicts about worth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following accusations relocate honor and humiliation from the amount one receives to the way provision moves through social relations. Honor is enacted toward a person cut off from a caretaker; nourishment is given outward, while inheritance is consumed, gathered, loved, and accumulated. The focus person's possessive provision becomes a test of circulation rather than a private status meter.

activation_trace.role: Provision as an allotted gift anchors the social question in what has been assigned, not absolutely owned.
Nourishing food makes provision functionally shareable and life-sustaining.
Humiliation through contempt supplies the status category that the social sequence relocates.
Praised honor and generosity become an outward practice toward another person.
A child cut off from a caretaker identifies the social location where honor must be supplied.
Feeding another turns nourishment from possessed quantity into an outward act.
Consuming and taking property supplies the opposite motion, drawing shared wealth inward.
Gathering dispersed things into one mass makes inward concentration explicit.
Love fixed in the heart supplies the affective force that keeps wealth from circulating.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth identifies the object turned into a status store.
Accumulation until fullness completes the anti-circulation mechanism.

structural_cues: The singular self-report in 89:16 is followed by plural accusations in 89:17-20.
The sequence contrasts outward honoring and feeding with inward consuming, gathering, loving, and accumulating.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies honor, severed care, feeding, consumption, gathering, attachment, wealth, and fullness; I infer a flow model in which the ethical meaning of provision depends on relation and circulation. The plural addressees may be broader than the focus speaker, so the connection is typological rather than a certain identity claim.

changed_reading.before: The person's own allotment determines whether he has been honored or humiliated.
changed_reading.after: Honor is tested by whether allotted nourishment becomes care for others; hoarded or devoured abundance can enact the very humiliation the speaker fears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later remembrance and a second saying replace the receipt ledger with a forward-action ledger. The person who presently defines himself by what was measured to him later wishes he had advanced something for life. The focus constriction thus becomes a temporal opportunity to revise action before retrospective speech can no longer do so.

activation_trace.role: Speech as a held doctrine anchors the present ledger of received status.
The allotted gift supplies what the person presently counts as the decisive input.
Recollection after prior absence supplies the delayed recognition that changes the ledger.
The interrogative of availability or whence marks the point at which recollection no longer yields usable action.
A second utterance provides the later self-interpretation against which the focus utterance is reread.
Advancing forward changes value from what arrived to the person into what the person sent ahead.
Life as benefit and good names the destination of the action that should have been advanced.

structural_cues: The speech verb recurs at 89:24 after the judgment scene and remembrance at 89:23.
The first speech looks backward at what was received; the later speech looks backward at what was not sent forward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present belief, later recollection, another utterance, forward movement, and beneficial life; I infer a temporal reversal from receipt to contribution. The alternative is that the two sayings belong to different rhetorical moments without implying that constriction itself offered a corrective opportunity.

changed_reading.before: The important deficit is the provision withheld from me.
changed_reading.after: The later saying reveals a different deficit: what I failed to advance while I still treated received provision as the measure of my life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later passage directly names punitive pain and binding, whereas the focus places humiliation inside the person's speech. This grammatical and lexical contrast strengthens the distinction between an experienced contraction, an attributed insult, and an explicitly asserted judgment.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech marks the humiliation claim as the person's voiced attribution.
Humiliation through contempt supplies the alleged status injury whose narrative status is at issue.
Pain and punishment provide an explicit later category for actual penal action.
Binding with a fastening supplies a second directly asserted form of judgment.

structural_cues: The focus humiliation is syntactically quoted after a speech verb.
Verses 89:25-26 state punishment and binding directly rather than as the person's interpretation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a quoted humiliation claim and later explicit punishment and binding; I infer that the contrast withholds narrative ratification from the earlier equation. The alternative is that constriction can still function as chastening without being identical to the later final punishment.

changed_reading.before: Constricted provision is already an explicit punitive sentence.
changed_reading.after: Constricted provision is a test that the person calls humiliation, while the passage reserves direct penal language for a later judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root inventory itself holds both contemptuous abasement and gentle composure. The final sequence adds an inward self, tranquility, sensory lowering, return, and mutual contentment. Together they activate a competing response to reduced circumstances: lowering can become settled receptivity without becoming worthlessness.

activation_trace.role: Calm dignity with gentleness supplies a non-contemptuous mode of low or easy bearing within the focus root.
Humiliation through contempt preserves the opposed reading that the speaker actually voices.
The mind and inner awareness locate the alternative response in the interpreting self.
Stillness and tranquility supply the affective alternative to the focus verdict.
Physical lowering links composure to descent without requiring degradation.
Return to a prior relation supplies the directional completion of settled trust.
Mutual contentment supplies a reciprocal status relation not indexed by material quantity.

structural_cues: The closing vocative addresses the interpreting self rather than its possessions.
The final imperatives move through return and entry, contrasting the focus speaker's immediate verbal closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed branches under the focus root plus tranquility, lowering, return, and mutual contentment; I infer a phenomenological fork in how constrained conditions can be inhabited. This is not a claim that the causative focus form literally means tranquility; the direct humiliation sense remains primary and the calm reading is an activated countermodel.

changed_reading.before: Being brought low can only mean being treated as contemptible.
changed_reading.after: The same field can support an exploratory distinction between degrading contempt and composed lowering, so constrained circumstances need not settle the self's worth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the non-dominant split mapping of the speech root toward fewness, so it is surprising and must not replace the ordinary syntax of saying. It remains anchored to the focus speech, constriction, and humiliation sequence, and downstream prose should present it only as a latent enactment: the utterance may turn quantitative little into qualitative littleness of self.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speech at word 8 immediately converts the scanting at word 5 into humiliation at word 10.

Contemptuous abasement supplies the qualitative smallness produced by the interpretation.

changed_reading.before: The person neutrally reports a humiliation caused before he speaks.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the saying participates in the harm by verbalizing little provision as a little self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The false-pretext image comes from a non-dominant mapped root and is form-distant, so it cannot establish that the focus verb means lying. It remains worth carrying because the claim is explicitly quoted and is followed by failures of honor and feeding; downstream prose should qualify it as a possible self-exonerating use of the complaint, not an accusation proved by the root alone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The person's voiced humiliation claim at words 8-10 is the possible alibi, while the focus constriction supplies its plausible circumstance.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance makes the status claim available as a socially operative explanation.
False speech used as a pretext activates the possibility that the humiliation verdict excuses later inaction.
Praised honor and generosity identify one action the scarcity story may be used to avoid.
Feeding another identifies the second outward obligation against which the complaint can function as an alibi.

changed_reading.before: The complaint is only a sincere description of deprivation.
changed_reading.after: It may also function as a self-protective story: because I was diminished, I owe no outward honor or nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading crosses from the focus humiliation root's split service branch to the later servant root, so it is a structural resonance rather than a lexical paraphrase of the focus verb. It stays anchored in the person's relation to his Lord and the focus root, and downstream prose should render it as an exploratory reversal in which dependence and service can carry dignity instead of disgrace.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speaker names his Lord at word 9 and interprets his dependent condition through the split root at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Lordship as ownership and authority supplies the relation that the speaker experiences as status dependence.
Service and practiced work-skill provide a non-dominant alternative to mere contempt within the focus root mapping.
Entry into an interior gives the servant relation an endpoint of belonging rather than exclusion.
Humble obedience supplies the service relation explicitly.
Honor and exaltation reverse the assumption that service under lordship must be humiliating.

changed_reading.before: Dependence on a Lord under restricted provision is inherently degrading.
changed_reading.after: The closing servant relation activates the possibility that dependence, skilled service, and humble obedience can culminate in honored belonging.

strongest_changes: The 89:15 mirror makes abundance and constriction parallel disclosure conditions rather than opposite verdicts of worth.
Verses 89:17-20 relocate honor from possessed quantity to the circulation of care and nourishment.
The later saying at 89:24 changes the ledger from what was received to what was advanced for life.
The focus humiliation root retains a live distinction between contempt, actual wear, and composed lowering.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mappings keep incompatible but anchored readings alive: speech can expose belief or latently perform fewness, and the humiliation field can indicate contempt, material wear, weakened agency, calm dignity, or service. Context does not collapse these into one answer; it redistributes their force.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus measure can emphasize active restriction, exact proportion, or deliberative administration, and the form does not force only one mechanism.
The plural social accusations may describe the focus speaker's type without proving that they refer to the identical individual.
The complaint may be theologically mistaken while remaining phenomenologically accurate about scarcity's real damage.
Non-dominant split-root activations should remain explicitly exploratory in downstream prose.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Restriction as measured testing.** Lexical evidence: `ب ل و B002` testing and disclosure; `ق د ر B004` narrowing to a scant measure; `ق د ر B001` measured amount/extent; `ر ز ق B001` provision as allotted gift. Structural cue: the ayah mirrors 89:15: the same test-frame receives a different provision-state. Assigned role: narrowed provision functions as a measure that reveals the human’s reading of worth. Abductive move: I infer that constriction is calibrated rather than contemptuous because `ق د ر` also carries measure and estimate. Reading change: scarcity reads as test-disclosure, not divine belittlement.

2. **Humiliation misread against possible calm dignity.** Lexical evidence: `ه و ن B003` humiliation and abasement through contempt; `ه و ن B001` calm dignity with gentleness; `ه و ن B002` lightness/ease. Structural cue: the human says `أهانن`, but 89:27 later offers `النفس المطمئنة`. Assigned role: the root’s humiliation branch is the human’s claim; the calm branch is a suppressed alternative response. Abductive move: I infer that the later tranquil soul shows another way to inhabit constriction without translating it into contempt. Reading change: the ayah reads as a failed affective interpretation of measured provision.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:27 made the hidden alternative in `ه و ن` visible: calm dignity could have answered restriction, but the human chooses the humiliation reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Measured constriction misnamed as contempt.** **Evidence/cue:** `ق د ر B001` is measure reaching a thing's extent and `ق د ر B004` is narrowing to a scant measure; `ر ز ق B001` is allotted provision. The speaker instead selects `ه و ن B003`, humiliation by contempt, while 89:15 has already marked both conditions as `ب ل و B002`, disclosure by testing. **Mechanism:** measurement sets the test's changed limit, whereas the speaker supplies an unsupported arrow from less provision to diminished worth. **Reading change:** the ayah exposes “my Lord humiliated me” as a causal overreading of quantity, not as the packet's account of the constriction.

2. **“His provision” as a social allotment, not sealed private property.** **Evidence/cue:** `ر ز ق B001/B002` supplies allotted gift and nourishing food; 89:17-20 moves through orphan-care, feeding, inherited shares, and gathered wealth. **Mechanism:** provision enters a network in which some portion can sustain others, so constriction tests how the person handles circulation as much as scarcity. The packet supplies the network; I infer that possession carries distributive responsibility. **Reading change:** *rizqahu* is read as a measured resource within social transfer, weakening the speaker's equation of private amount with personal rank.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:17-20 made “his provision” unexpectedly relational: orphan, food, legacy, and wealth showed what a social allotment can fail to do. 89:21 then corrected the speaker's private humiliation claim by reserving actual crushing and leveling for the earth, not equating a measured ration with personal contempt.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو

يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء
يدخل فيه الربرب لقطيع بقر الوحش، وقيل لجماعة البقر أو الإبل
يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çocuk veya ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlama ile bir topluluk içinde yetişip gelişme yönlerini aynı büyüme sürecinde birleştirir. Ettirgen bakım ile yetişenin kendi gelişimi katılımcı bakımından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Besleyip büyütme, bunun sonucu gelişme ve bir topluluk içinde yetişme kullanımları katılımcı değişimleri korunarak ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Çocuk ya da ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlamak veya bu bakımın etkisiyle büyümektir. Kişinin bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişmesi de bu sürecin toplumsal yönüdür.

facets.statement: Büyüyen varlık beslenir ve gelişmesi sağlanır.
Beslenen çocuk veya ürün bakımın sonucu olarak büyür.
Kişi belirli bir topluluğun içinde yetişip gelişebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar beslemeyi büyümenin nedeni, büyümeyi de bakımın sonucu olarak ilişkilendirir; çocuk ve ürün bu yapının örnekleridir, topluluk içinde yetişme ise katılımcı yönünü değiştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın beslenerek geliştirilmesini ve yetişenin bu süreçte büyümesini birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Besleyen kişinin etkisini, büyüyenin gelişimini ve yetişme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çocuk veya ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığın bakım ve besin yoluyla geliştirildiği bağlama uygundur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel hizmet ve iş becerisi anlamlarını belirli kişi, topluluk, aile ve toprak yapılarından ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, birine hizmet etmeyi ve bir işi beceriyle yapmayı kapsar. Belirli kullanımlarda hizmet eden kişiyi, bir topluluğa ya da aileye hizmeti ve kişinin kendi toprağında çalışmasını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kullanarak değerden düşürmeyi merkez alır, fakat doğrudan güçsüzleştirmeyi, kişinin kendini hizmete vermesini ve bir hayvanın koşu gücünü sonuna kadar kullandırmayı da içerir. Bu yüzden dal yalnız nesnenin kullanımla eskimesi olarak değil, kullanıma koşma sonucunda değer veya gücün azalması ve bunun doğrudan güçsüzleştirme uzantısı olarak tanımlanmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kullanıma koşma ve güçten düşürme biçimlerini ayırır; nesne, kişinin kendisi, aile hizmeti ve hayvan gücü yapıları kendi sınırlarında kalır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi veya kişiyi kullanıma koşarak değerini, gücünü ya da kullanılabilir kapasitesini azaltmaktır; ayrıca bir şeyi doğrudan güçsüzleştirme anlamına uzanır. Kendini hizmete verme ve bir hayvanın bütün koşu gücünü harcatma bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi kullanıma sokarak değerini düşürmek veya yıpratmak temel çekirdektir.
Bir şeyi doğrudan güçsüzleştirme, kullanımla azalma çekirdeğinin sonuç odaklı uzantısıdır.
Kişinin kendini hizmet için kullanması veya aile işlerine vermesi, insan katılımcılı özel biçimdir.
Bir hayvanın var olan koşu gücünü sonuna kadar kullandırıp tüketmek, kapasite azalmasına örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, nesneyi kullanarak değerden düşürme ile doğrudan güçsüzleştirmeyi aynı alanda verir. Kendini hizmete verme, aile işlerinde kullanıma girme ve hayvanın koşu kapasitesini tüketme bu alanın özel kullanımlarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yumuşaklıkla birleşen sakinlik ve ağırbaşlılığı hem yalın anlam olarak hem de yürüyüş, söz söyleme ve huy bağlamlarında açıkça destekler. Kişinin kendini büyütmemesi de yalnızca onur kırıcı bir durum doğurmadığı ölçüde bu olumlu alana girer.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimdeki sakinlik ve ağırbaşlılık çekirdeğini korur; yürüme, ağırdan alma ve huyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca kendi kalıplaşmış bağlamlarında gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşaklıkla birleşen, sertlikten ve taşkınlıktan uzak sakinlik ve ağırbaşlılıktır. Yürüyüşte ölçülü ilerleme, söz ve işte acele etmeme, huyda uysallık ya da onur kaybı doğurmadan kendini geri tutma biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Anlamın çekirdeği, yumuşaklıkla birleşen sakinlik ve ağırbaşlılıktır.
Yürüyüşte telaşsız, sakin ve ağırbaşlı biçimde ilerlemeyi anlatır.
Söz söylerken ya da bir işi yaparken acele etmeden, kendi sakin temposunda davranmayı anlatır.
İnsan huyunda sertlikten uzak, uysal, nazik ve geçimli olma niteliğine uzanır.
Kişinin onurunu zedelemeyen bir ölçüde kendini büyütmemesi ve geri planda tutması da bu alanda değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık ve yumuşaklıktır; yürüyüş, söz söyleme ve insan huyu bu çekirdeğin başlıca gerçekleşme alanlarıdır. Onur kırıcı olmayan ölçülü bir kendini geri tutma da olumlu bir sınır durum olarak yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana çizgisi bir işin kişiye kolay ve hafif gelmesi, kolaylaştırılması ve göreli olarak daha kolay olmasıdır. Bununla birlikte bir şeyi hafife alıp ciddiyeti az sayan kullanım da bulunduğundan dal yalnızca nesnel kolaylıkla sınırlandırılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kolay ve hafif olma niteliğini; birine kolay gelme, kolaylaştırma, karşılaştırma ve hafife alma gibi katılımcı ya da yapı bağımlı gerçekleşmelerden ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin ya da şeyin kişiye güçlük ve ağırlık çıkarmaması, kolay ve hafif gelmesi; ayrıca bunun kolaylaştırılması, hafifletilmesi veya göreli olarak daha kolay olmasıdır. Bağlama göre bir şeyi ciddiyeti az ya da önemsiz sayma değerlendirmesine uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir işin veya şeyin zorlayıcı olmaması, kolay ve hafif nitelik taşıması anlamın çekirdeğidir.
Bir işin belirli bir kişiye kolay gelmesi ve ona ağır bir yük oluşturmaması anlatılır.
Bir failin işi başka biri için kolaylaştırması ve yükünü hafifletmesi anlatılır.
Karşılaştırmada bir seçeneğin diğerinden daha kolay veya daha hafif olması belirtilir.
Bir şeyin ciddiyetini düşük görerek onu hafife alma ya da önemsiz sayma değerlendirmesi de bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, işin veya şeyin zor ve ağır olmaması, kişiye kolay gelmesi ya da bir failce kolaylaştırılmasıdır. Karşılaştırmalı kolaylık ve bağlama bağlı hafife alma değerlendirmesi aynı geniş alanın ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهون: مصدر هان عليه الشيء أي خف؛ هونه الله عليه أي سهله وخففه؛ شيء هين أي سهل (sihah)؛ هان الأمر على فلان: سهل؛ هو علي هين؛ وهو أهون عليه؛ وتحسبونه هينا (mufradat)؛ الهين: الأمر الهين وهو من الواو وقد مر (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aşağılanma, değersizlik, güçsüzlük ve onur kaybını; bunlara yol açan küçümseme ve küçük düşürme eylemleriyle birlikte açıkça verir. Özellikle daha güçlü bir tarafın hor görmesiyle doğan katılımcı ilişkisi, dalın olumsuz sınırını belirler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın aşağılanma ve değersizlik durumunu; birini küçük düşürme, hor görme ve aşağılayıcı ceza gibi fail ya da yapı bağımlı gerçekleşmelerden ayrı gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyin küçümsenmesi sonucunda değer ve onur kaybederek aşağı bir duruma düşmesi ya da düşürülmesidir. Daha güçlü bir tarafın hor görmesi, birini küçük düşürmesi veya bir şeyi değersiz sayması bu olumsuz alanın eylem ve tutum biçimleridir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, küçümsenmeyle bağlantılı aşağılanma, onur kaybı, değersizlik ve güçsüzlük durumudur.
Bir kişinin veya şeyin başkalarının gözünde değersiz, önemsiz ve saygıya layık görülmemesi anlatılır.
Daha güçlü bir failin kişiyi hor görerek aşağılaması ve onu küçük düşürmesi anlatılır.
Birini veya bir şeyi hakir görüp önemsememe ve ona küçümseyerek davranma tutumunu kapsar.
Cezanın kişiyi aşağılayan ve küçük düşüren niteliği bu dalın belirgin bir uygulamasıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ضعف الشيء والإنسان والعظم والبدن والعمل والأمر، ووهَن الإنسان أو الشيء، ووهنه غيره أو أوهنه، والفتور والجبن عن القتال، وإضعاف الكيد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وهن الشيء يهن وهنا: ضعف، وأوهنته أنا (maqayis)؛ الوهن الضعف في العمل وفي الأشياء وكذلك في العظم ونحوه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الوهن: الضعف، وقد وهن الإنسان ووهنه غيره، يتعدى ولا يتعدى (sihah)؛ فما فتروا وما جبنوا عن قتال عدوهم (tahdhib)؛ الوهن: ضعف من حيث الخلق أو الخلق، موهن كيد الكافرين (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الوهن والموهن بمعنى ساعة من الليل، نحو نصف الليل أو حين يدبر الليل، وأوهن الرجل إذا دخل أو سار في تلك الساعة.
يدخل فيه اسم الواهنة للقصيرى من الأضلاع أو أسفلها، وللعرق أو الموضع المستبطن من حبل العاتق إلى الكتف، ولعظمي ترقوة البعير.
يدخل فيه داء الواهنة أو وجعها، وما يصيب الإنسان في أخدعيه أو عضد الرجل أو رأس منكبيه، وتسميته موهونا أو واهنة.
يدخل فيه الوهنانة من النساء: قليلة الحركة، ثقيلة القيام والقعود، أو التي فيها فتور وأناة وكسل عن العمل تنعما.
يدخل فيه الوهن من الإبل بمعنى الكثيف كما في نص الصحاح.
يدخل فيه الوهين بلغة أهل مضر: رجل يكون مع الأجير في العمل يحثه على العمل.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım belirli söz kalıbına ve onun bahane üretme işlevine bağlı tutulur; yalın köke genel yalan veya boş söz anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir söz kalıbıyla, kendine mazeret oluşturmak üzere asılsız veya boş sözler söylemeyi anlatan kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Söylenen sözler asılsız, boş veya gerçeğe dayanmayan niteliktedir.
Konuşan kişi bu sözleri kendine bir mazeret veya bahane oluşturmak için kullanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal, belirli bir söz kalıbını asılsız veya boş konuşup bunu mazeret olarak kullanma işleviyle tanımlar. Gerçek dışılık ile bahane üretme amacı anlamın birlikte korunması gereken iki yönüdür.

source_details.summary: Tekil tanıklık, söz kalıbını asılsız konuşarak kendine bahane üretme durumuyla sınırlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli söz kalıbının hem asılsızlık hem de bahane üretme işlevini kısa biçimde temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sözün asılsızlığını ve mazeret oluşturmak üzere söylenmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.text: bahane olsun diye asılsız sözler söylemek
contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin gerçeğe dayanmayan sözleri kendini mazur göstermek veya oyalanmak için ileri sürdüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Asılsız konuşma eylemini ve bu eylemin bahane üretme amacını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bahane olsun diye asılsız sözler söyledi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal asılsız sözü belirli bir kalıba ve konuşanın kendine mazeret üretme amacına bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gerçeğe aykırı bir iddiada bulunmayı veya doğru olmayan herhangi bir söz söylemeyi genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bahane sözü ile genel asılsız iddia
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gerçeğe dayanmayan söz söylemeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel asılsız iddia alanındadır; bu dal ise belirli bir söz kalıbıyla bahane üretme işlevini zorunlu kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal boş veya asılsız sözün mazeret olarak kullanılmasını ve belirli yapıya bağlı olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal asılsız, boş ve yararsız sözleri amaç veya yapı sınırlaması olmadan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: mazeret amaçlı boş söz ile genel boş söz
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da asılsız veya boş konuşma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada sözün bir bahane işlevi vardır ve kullanım belirli bir kalıba bağlıdır; komşu dalda bu amaç ve yapı koşulu yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın ayırt edici yönü, gerçeğe dayanmayan sözü bahane olarak kullanmaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal boş sözün yanında çirkin, sövgülü, suçlayıcı veya ahlakça sakıncalı konuşmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bahane sözü ile çirkin boş konuşma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal boş veya gerçeğe dayanmayan konuşmayı içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal mazeret işlevine odaklanır ve çirkinlik gerektirmez; komşu dal ise sözün kötü, saldırgan veya sakıncalı niteliğine kadar genişler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Seçilen üç karşılaştırma yapıyı genel asılsız iddiadan, amaçsız boş sözden ve çirkin konuşmadan ayırır; kalanlar başka boş söz adları, konuşma eylemleri, söylem araçları veya bağımsız kök anlamlarıdır.

root_profile.summary: Kök, genel güç ve kararlılık kaybı çekirdeğinin yanında gecenin belirli bir saati, çeşitli anatomik yapılar, üst bedendeki özel bir ağrı, ağır hareket eden kadın, yoğun deve topluluğu, işçiyi teşvik eden kişi, bahane amaçlı asılsız söz ve leşten ağırlaşıp havalanamayan kuş anlamlarını taşır. Bu dalların bir bölümü güç, gevşeklik veya ağırlık düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirilebilirken bir bölümü bağımsız sözlüksel kullanımlardır.
